the-material-family.banner: Drag to walk around. Turn the light to night and see what still shines.

words.meshBasic: one flat colour, blind to every lamp
words.meshLambert: matte like chalk: diffuse light, no shine
words.meshPhong: plastic: a bright spot where the sun bounces
words.meshStandard: metalness and roughness, the usual choice
words.meshPhysical: standard plus glass: light passes through
words.meshToon: a cartoon: the light in two flat bands
words.meshNormal: the way each point faces, as a colour
words.meshMatcap: lit by a picture of a lit ball, not by lamps

controls.keys: The engine's character control: the menu's Play locks the mouse to look, W A S D to run (Z Q S D on AZERTY), Shift to sprint, Space to jump, Escape frees the mouse. The page adds R to run again, M to mute.
